newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.

text.p: Oct 17 - U.S. stock index futures ended mostly higher. Traders said late action picked up again, with the strong close in T-bond futures further supporting values. But Dec S&P 500s backed off from another new contract high and trendline resistance extrapolated near 713.05. Brokers said a string of decent corporate earnings also added lift. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
The string of decent corporate earnings on Thursday, coupled with the ability of futures to stay above support zones, propped up values as well.
"We were trading off the bonds a lot...and good quarterly earnings," said one S&P 500 futures floor broker.
But he also said nearby S&P 500s, which brushed a new high at 713.20, reverted to a range-trade during the afternoon.

Technicians waited to see whether the contract would try to decisively pierce trendline resistance drawn at the 713.10 level after it had bounced up strongly from support near the day's low at 708.65.
It also briefly straddled resistance at the old high of 712.50.
"Basically, what we were doing was bouncing off these areas," added the floor broker.

Traders saw only limited evidence of index arbitrage on Thursday. One firm pegged fair value in December S&P 500s at 4.20 points premium, buy programs at 5.40 points or wider premium and sell programs at 3.20 points or narrower premium.

Dec S&P 500s rose 2.40 pts to 711.00, Midcap 400s rose 0.40 to 247.25, Value Lines eased 0.25 to 652.05, NYFE Composite rose 1.60 to 378.35, Nikkei rose 5.0 to 21,535.0. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
